name: Cenergy Holdings SA
summary: Cenergy Holdings SA manufactures and sells aluminium, copper, cables, steel and steel pipes, and other related products in Belgium, Greece, Germany, Romania, Other European Union countries, Other European countries, the United States, Asia, Africa, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Cables and Steel Pipes.
